# three.ws

> three.ws is the AI-agent layer for the open web: build, embed, monetize, and trade autonomous agents with real 3D avatars, on-chain identity (ERC-8004), pay-per-call (x402), and pump.fun token launches.

Tagline: Give your AI a body.
Site: https://three.ws
Source: https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws
Examples: https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws/tree/main/examples
Contact: https://x.com/trythreews

## Official

The only official three.ws website is https://three.ws. A site on any other domain that presents itself as three.ws is not affiliated with us.

- Website: https://three.ws
- X: https://x.com/trythreews
- Telegram: https://t.me/three_ws
- GitHub: https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws
- $THREE token mint on Solana: FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump (https://three.ws/three-token)

This is the only official $THREE mint. Check the full address before you buy: any other token using the name is an impersonation.

## For AI agents

Machine-readable entry points. Fetch these instead of scraping HTML.

- [sitemap.xml](https://three.ws/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search-engine crawlers.
- [MCP trust policy](https://three.ws/api/mcp-policy): A ready-to-paste allowlist telling an AI client which three.ws MCP tools it may run without asking you. Three profiles from strict to open, in Claude, VS Code, or portable format, derived from the tool safety labels that are verified against each handler on every build.
- [prompts.json](https://three.ws/prompts.json): The prompt library as structured data: categories, setup tiers, tags, and every prompt with what it returns.
- [prompts.txt](https://three.ws/prompts.txt): The prompt library as plain text, for piping straight into an assistant.
- [llms.txt](https://three.ws/llms.txt): Curated AI-agent index (llmstxt.org convention): the official domain, accounts and $THREE mint, the machine-readable entry points, and the key pages, with llms-full.txt for the complete list.
- [llms-full.txt](https://three.ws/llms-full.txt): Expanded llms.txt with full descriptions and content hints.
- [skill.md](https://three.ws/skill.md): The three.ws Agent Skill: how an AI agent connects to three.ws, the rules it follows around money and official addresses, and an index of the focused skills for 3D generation, avatars and agents. Load it like any SKILL.md.
- [robots.txt](https://three.ws/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
- [OpenAPI](https://three.ws/openapi.json): Machine-readable HTTP API spec.
- [.well-known/x402](https://three.ws/.well-known/x402): x402 paid-API discovery document.
- [.well-known/agent-attestation-schemas](https://three.ws/.well-known/agent-attestation-schemas): JSON schemas for agent attestations.
- [.well-known/oauth-authorization-server](https://three.ws/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): OAuth 2.1 authorization-server metadata.
- [.well-known/chat-plugin.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/chat-plugin.json): ChatGPT-style plugin manifest.
- [MCP server](https://three.ws/api/mcp): Hosted Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP): avatars, glTF validation, agent data, and memory as tools. Six more hosted servers are listed in /.well-known/mcp.json.
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/mcp.json): Directory of every hosted three.ws MCP server: endpoint, transport, auth, and what each one does.
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A agent card: what three.ws is, what it can do, and where the paid-service catalog lives.
- [.well-known/x402.json](https://three.ws/.well-known/x402.json): x402 service catalog: every paid pay-per-call endpoint with price, network, and input schema.

## Start here

- [Home](https://three.ws/): Landing page. 3D AI agents that think on IBM watsonx.ai (Granite): the pitch, live agent demos, and the front door to every flow.
- [What is three.ws?](https://three.ws/what-is): Plain-English introduction to three.ws: what a 3D AI agent is, real use-cases, and where to begin.
- [Create](https://three.ws/create): The front door for everything you can create on three.ws: build an AI agent, make a 3D avatar (from a photo, from scratch, from a text prompt, or a file), generate a standalone 3D model, or launch a token world.
- [Forge: Text & Image to 3D](https://three.ws/forge): Type a prompt, or drop in photos or a sketch, and get a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB). Pick from multiple generation engines with live health status.
- [Image to 3D: Turn a Photo into a 3D Model](https://three.ws/image-to-3d): Upload a photo (or up to 6 angles) and get a downloadable textured 3D model (GLB). The Forge's photo lane, opened directly: for objects and props; for faces, use Selfie to Avatar.
- [Create an Agent](https://three.ws/create-agent): Step-by-step wizard to create a 3D AI agent: name, 3D body, skills, personality, voice, and on-chain identity.
- [Agents Index](https://three.ws/agents): Browse every registered agent on three.ws.
- [Marketplace](https://three.ws/marketplace): Buy access to agents, skills, and avatars from other creators.
- [Agent Spotlight](https://three.ws/spotlight): The three.ws community showcase: agents people actually built something with, written up by the builder and ranked by community upvotes. Filter by category, open any entry in 3D, upvote what you like, and submit your own.

## Developers

- [Connect three.ws to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor & VS Code](https://three.ws/connect): Add three.ws to your AI client in two clicks: one connector URL gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or Claude Code the three.ws MCP tools for 3D generation, agents, wallets and x402 payments. Sign in once in your browser, with no API key to copy.
- [MCP Tool Catalog](https://three.ws/mcp-tools): Every MCP tool three.ws publishes, searchable in one place: what it does, which server hosts it, what it costs in USDC, and whether an AI client can run it unattended. Generated from the source of each tool, so it never drifts from what the servers serve.
- [Docs · Start Here](https://three.ws/docs/start-here): Plain-language introduction to three.ws for creators and non-developers: what it is, who it’s for, and where to begin.
- [Docs · MCP](https://three.ws/docs/mcp): Expose your agent as an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, and other clients.
- [Docs · three-ws CLI](https://three.ws/docs/cli): Connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Hermes to three.ws in one command: npx three-ws setup signs you in, writes every client's MCP config and verifies each server with a live tools/list.
- [Docs · API Reference](https://three.ws/docs/api-reference): Full HTTP API reference.
- [Avatar SDK](https://three.ws/avatar-sdk): The @three-ws/avatar package: embed the platform 3D avatars in any site with a few lines of JavaScript.
- [3D API](https://three.ws/3d): Free, keyless 3D API for AI agents: turn a text prompt into a real GLB model and validate/optimize any glTF/GLB, all from one URL with a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Free draft generation and inspection graduate to paid Forge Pro quality tiers and animation-ready Rigged Avatars. No key, no account.
- [Crypto API](https://three.ws/crypto-api): One free, keyless API for on-chain and market data: DEX pairs, prices, swap quotes, TVL, Solana RPC reads, and ENS/SNS name resolution: CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Jupiter, DexScreener and Solana RPC bundled behind one bill. Live provider table rendered from the real registry, generated OpenAPI 3.1 spec, free tier then BYOK, plan, or x402 pay-per-call.
- [Docs · x402 Protocol](https://three.ws/docs/x402): How three.ws implements x402 HTTP 402 paid agent skills: the challenge, verify, and settle mechanics.
- [x402 Catalog](https://three.ws/x402): A live catalog of pay-per-call APIs settled on-chain in USDC over the x402 protocol. Search, inspect the schema, and run any endpoint.
- [Docs · Skills](https://three.ws/docs/skills): Write, package, and monetize agent skills.
- [Prompt Library](https://three.ws/prompts): Copy-paste prompts for Claude and any AI agent: generate a 3D model or a rigged avatar, embed one on a site, validate a GLB, find or sell a paid API in the agent economy. Most of them need no account, no key and no setup.

## Economy and $THREE

- [$THREE Token](https://three.ws/three-token): The $THREE protocol token: live price, a live DEXTools chart, streaming trades, programmatic buybacks, DEXTools Social Boost wins, and one-click buy.
- [$THREE Tiers · Hold-to-Access](https://three.ws/three): Hold $THREE to unlock platform-wide perks: fee discounts on compute, higher free quotas, and private and branded worlds. See every tier, what it unlocks, and exactly how much $THREE you hold to reach the next one. The same tiering and the same upgrade path, everywhere.
- [$THREE Launchpad](https://three.ws/three-launchpad): A bonding-curve launchpad priced in $THREE: every coin launched for a 3D agent is bought with $THREE, creators earn their fees in $THREE, and each graduation locks the $THREE it raised in a pool nobody can withdraw. Launch a coin or trade the live curves.
- [Launch a Coin](https://three.ws/launch): The pump.fun launchpad for 3D AI agents: pick your agent, name the coin, launch it from your wallet or the agent's wallet, and claim creator rewards on three.ws.
- [Agent Launches](https://three.ws/launches): Live public feed of every coin launched by a three.ws agent: market caps, graduation status, and the agent behind each launch.
- [Pay (x402)](https://three.ws/pay): Pay-per-call gateway: invoke any x402-protocol paid API with a USDC micro-transaction.
- [Credits](https://three.ws/credits): Top up with SOL or $THREE and spend credits on 3D generation, agents, and compute. Hold $THREE for up to 30% off every spend.
- [Pricing](https://three.ws/pricing): Plans and pricing for three.ws: free forge quota, premium passes, and pay-per-use API surfaces.
- [The Agent Economy: Live](https://three.ws/economy): The live three.ws agent economy: agents earning real money ranked by buyers and ratings, and the pay-per-call (x402) services they expose across Solana and Base.
- [Platform Analytics](https://three.ws/analytics): Every three.ws platform total on one page, read live: agents, agents with a wallet, coins launched, 3D models generated, LLM tokens processed, x402 settlements and volume, marketplace sales and agent-to-agent hire volume, each with a daily growth chart over 30 days, 90 days or all time and a note on exactly how it is counted.

## Learn

- [Docs](https://three.ws/docs): Full documentation: SDKs, API reference, embedding, agent system, smart contracts.
- [Tutorials](https://three.ws/tutorials): Step-by-step build guides.
- [Examples](https://three.ws/examples): Runnable three.ws examples: copy-paste snippets that execute on the page against the production CDN bundle, plus every example that ships in the repository, generated by scanning it. Each one lists the files it contains and the command that runs it.
- [Awesome 3D Agents](https://three.ws/awesome): A curated, link-checked list of everything you need to give an AI agent a body: text-to-3D models, capture and Gaussian splatting, avatars, rigging, motion generation, lipsync and voice, web renderers, asset pipelines, and the agent frameworks that drive them. Searchable and filterable, and published as an awesome list on GitHub.
- [Changelog](https://three.ws/changelog): What is new on three.ws: features, improvements, and releases, newest first.
- [Blog](https://three.ws/blog): Editorial index of three.ws launches and long-form posts.
- [Status](https://three.ws/status): Live operational status and 90-day uptime history for the platform, API, and x402 surfaces: probed every 5 minutes.
- [Experiments](https://three.ws/experiments): What three.ws tried, what it cost, what the numbers said and what we got wrong. Every write-up is measured from production data and ends with the queries that produced its numbers, filterable by running, concluded or killed.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://three.ws/llms-full.txt): Every public page (929), grouped by section, with full descriptions.
- [Sitemap](https://three.ws/sitemap): The same index for people, with search.
- [sitemap.xml](https://three.ws/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlers, including every agent and avatar page.
